The '''Kishpaugh spaceport''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kishpaugh]] deep inside the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Nelvana Gas Cluster/Legends|Nelvana Gas Cluster]]. A hub of smuggling, it attracted criminals of all stripes. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited the spaceport to deliver a shipment of parts to [[Tookra]].
